component.name: ELTuxUSB
component.summary: Linux support for Lascar EL-USB data loggers

description.p: ELTuxUSB reads, configures and downloads recordings from the EL-USB-1, EL-USB-2 and EL-USB-2-LCD data loggers from Lascar Electronics. Downloaded data can be exported as CSV files and plotted as graphs.
Port to Python 3, GTK4 and libadwaita.
